intro: Wake up to a better tomorrow with the Ortho Plus. Designed for perfect spine alignment and plush comfort, its dual-sided build adapts to your needs, ensuring cool, restorative sleep every night.

features.title: Soft foam for lasting comfort
features.text: Wake up feeling renewed! This mattress evenly distributes weight, relieving pressure points for a more restful and comfortable sleep.

features.title: Foam layer built for pure relaxation
features.text: Relax and unwind—this mattress evenly distributes weight, reducing joint pressure and enhancing overall relaxation.

features.title: Breathable cover for cool, dry comfort
features.text: Our moisture-wicking mattress design actively draws away heat and humidity, helping your sleeping surface stay cool, dry, and comfortable every night.

features.title: Flip sides for versatile use
features.text: With dual-sided firmness, our mattress offers plush comfort on one side and firm support on the other—so your sleep always suits your needs.

features.title: Promotes circulation for all-night comfort
features.text: Designed with precision, this mattress ensures optimal weight distribution, reducing pressure points across your body. By enhancing blood flow, it supports muscle recovery and relaxation, offering a healthier, more restorative sleep experience.

features.title: Perfectly sized for your bed frame
features.text: Redesign your bedroom your way. Our customisable dimensions ensure a flawless fit, blending seamlessly with your bed and matching your personal style.

name: Ortho Plus Queen Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 60 X 4 Inches
